review.readiness_note: Visual sign-off for this captured 390px revision state. The capture shows the necessary records, conditions, actions and navigation, but cannot verify Save responses, media destinations, upload/resubmission behavior or backend transitions. Those and narrower/enlarged-text layouts require separate functional QA.
review.why: This is a faithful translation of the system, not an inappropriate copy of the Home layout. The stepped reference–graphite–cobalt assembly remains recognizable, while the detail page prioritizes the actual revision workflow. Gross pay stays conditional, net and fee are explicitly distinguished, the business’s requested change is readable, and the previous file remains accessible despite having no preview. Upload precedes the longer brief and checks. No visible overlap, clipped amount, fabricated media or generic elevated-card treatment warrants an implementation correction.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift is faithfully transferred to this revision detail, with real functionality visibly preserved and no release-blocking visual drift at 390px.
